item.text:
Refactored the design one step further by removing the mutable builder and replacing it with a pure factory.

What changed:
- Replaced `UndirectedGraphBuilder` with [UndirectedGraphFactory.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/UndirectedGraphFactory.java), so graph construction is now a stateless transformation from edge list to immutable graph.
- Kept [UndirectedGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/UndirectedGraph.java) as a pure immutable model.
- Kept [BipartiteAnalyzer.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/BipartiteAnalyzer.java) dependent only on `GraphView`.
- Updated [BipartiteGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/BipartiteGraph.java) to use the new factory.

Why this is better:
- The previous builder was carrying mutable state without giving much benefit.
- The new factory makes the construction flow simpler and easier to reason about.
- The code now has a clearer split:
  - `UndirectedGraphFactory` builds
  - `UndirectedGraph` stores
  - `BipartiteAnalyzer` analyzes
